title: the hardware hunt
caption: Turns auction lots into fee-adjusted buying limits, using condition and resale evidence.
workflow: Track the lot, identify the hardware and estimate recoverable resale value. Include faults, buyer fees, VAT, transport and selling costs before setting a maximum hammer bid.
benefit: A cheap GPU stops being cheap surprisingly quickly.
demo: Change fees and failure risk; calculate the maximum bid that preserves a target profit.
source: poe/auctions/bidwatch.py, auction fee configuration and resale-floor workflow.
boundary: Authored hardware lots and editable fee assumptions. No live bids, account data or private buying limits.
